input.description: CSV samplesheet (must include headers: sample, fastq_1, fastq_2)

input_glob.description: Glob pattern for paired-end FASTQ (auto sample pair detection)

input_filelist.description: Plain file list (one FASTQ path per line)

sra_db.description: Path to SRA database. Will be downloaded if not supplied.

output_folder.description: Output directory for scrubbed FASTQ files

cpus.description: Number of CPU cores to allocate per job

mem_gbs.description: Memory (in GB) to allocate per job
